19976.Name: Mystic Coin
19976.Description:
Coins are used to create high-level weapons at the Mystic Forge in Lion's Arch. 
Part of Zommoros's favorite trades.

19977.Name: Pact Victory Token
19977.Description: Quartermaster Hargrove offers good service rewards in exchange for this symbol of victory.

19979.Name: Tournament Ticket
19979.Description: Used for tournaments which require an entry fee.

19980.Name: Black Lion Chest Key
19980.Description:
This key will unlock one Black Lion Chest containing random Gem Store merchandise, including some rare items not sold separately.

Black Lion Chests can be found randomly on enemies or bought from the trading post.

19983.Name: Mystic Forge Stone
19983.Description: Take this stone to the Mystic Forge to have Zommoros forge something special for you.

19984.Name: Bank Access Express
19984.Description: Double-click to access your account bank from anywhere. Single use.

19986.Name: Black Lion Salvage Kit
19986.Description: Double-click, then select an item in your inventory to salvage for crafting materials. 100% chance of recovering upgrades (excluding infusions). 50% chance to get rarer materials. Limited to 25 uses.

19988.Name: Limited-Use Cow Finisher
19988.Description: Crush your opponents with this falling cow finishing move in PvP and WvW.

19993.Name: Bag Slot Expansion
19993.Description: Add an extra bag slot to a character's inventory. The slot comes equipped with a basic bag. Each character can unlock up to 11 additional bag slots.

19995.Name: Bank Tab Expansion
19995.Description:
Double-click to add an extra bank tab to your account.
Each account can have up to 19 total bank tabs.

19996.Name: Revive Orb
19996.Description:
Rally from defeat at your current location.

This item cannot be used in raids, PvP, or WvW.

19997.Name: Experience Booster
19997.Description: Double-click to gain an enhancement that grants an additional 50% experience from kills for one hour.

19998.Name: Dye Pack
19998.Description:
Each dye box contains 7 random dyes (5 common and 2 uncommon or rare). 

Dyes can be unlocked for unlimited use to color armor on all characters. Dye bottles can also be recycled in the Mystic Forge.

<c=#FFC957>All common dyes have an equal chance to drop.

Rare or uncommon dye chances:
• Rare: ~20%
• Uncommon: ~80%</c>

19999.Name: Killstreak Experience Booster
19999.Description: Boost lasts for one hour. Kill streaks last 60 seconds from the most recent kill and can be restarted as often as necessary within the hour.

20000.Name: Box o' Fun
20000.Description: Double-click to create a box full of random goofs and gags! Lasts 15 minutes.

20001.Name: Karma Booster
20001.Description: Double-click to gain an enhancement that increases karma gained by 50% for one hour. Does not affect karma gained from consumable items.

20002.Name: Experience Booster
20002.Description:
Grants the following benefits for 2 hours:
• +50% Experience in All Game Types
• +50% Reward Track Gain in PvP and WvW
• Up to 100% Bonus Experience for Kill Streaks

20003.Name: Item Booster
20003.Description:
Grants the following benefits for 2 hours:
• +50% Magic Find
• +50% Chance of Critical Crafting Experience Gain
• +33% Chance of Extra Gathering Strike
• 10 seconds of Swiftness after Gathering
• Summons a Black Lion Merchant If Your Inventory Is Full after Gathering (20-Minute Cooldown)

20004.Name: Caithe's Bloom Dagger Skin
20004.Description: Double-click to apply this look to any other dagger.

20005.Name: Heroic Booster
20005.Description:
Grants both Experience Booster and Item Booster benefits for 2 hours, including:
• +50% Experience in All Game Types
• +50% Reward Track Gain in PvP and WvW
• Up to 100% Bonus Experience for Kill Streaks
• +50% Magic Find
• +50% Chance of Critical Crafting Experience Gain
• +33% Chance of Extra Gathering Strike
• 10 Seconds of Swiftness after Gathering 
• Summons a Black Lion Merchant If Your Inventory Is Full after Gathering (20-Minute Cooldown)

20006.Name: Magic Find Booster
20006.Description: Double-click to gain an enhancement that gives an additional 50% Magic Find for one hour.

20008.Name: Crafting Booster
20008.Description: Double-click to gain an enhancement that increases your chance to gain bonus experience from crafting by 50% for one hour.

20010.Name: Rejuvenation Booster
20010.Description: Double-click to gain a boon that regenerates health for one hour. Does not work in PvP, WvW, or raids.

20013.Name: Strength Booster
20013.Description: Double-click to gain a boon that increases your outgoing damage by 5% for one hour. Does not work in PvP, WvW, or raids.

20015.Name: Speed Booster
20015.Description: Double-click to gain a boon that increases your speed by 15% for one hour. Does not work in PvP, WvW, or raids.

20016.Name: Armor Booster
20016.Description: Double-click to gain a boon that reduces incoming damage by 5% for one hour. Does not work in PvP, WvW, or raids.

20017.Name: Trading Post Express
20017.Description: Double-click to summon a Black Lion Delivery Agent for 15 minutes, allowing you and your allies to pick up trading post purchases and profits. Single-use.

20018.Name: Merchant Express
20018.Description: Double-click to summon a Black Lion Merchant for 15 minutes, allowing you and your allies to access basic supplies and sell loot. Single-use.

20019.Name: Minis 3-Pack (Set 1)
20019.Description: Double-click to receive 3 randomly selected Minis (2 common and 1 uncommon) to add to your collection.

20021.Name: Booster Multipack
20021.Description: Contains boosts to increase karma gained, experience gained by killing enemies, and chance to find magic items. Each lasts one hour. Use all three at once, or each one individually!

20030.Name: Hall of Monuments Portal Stone
20030.Description: Double-click to travel to the ruins of the Hall of Monuments.

22375.Name: Ert's Unguent
22375.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
The stench of this is almost unbearable. One gulp and you'll understand why Ert is so green and angry all the time.

22380.Name: Cuatl Tonic
22380.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
There's a faint whiff of flies and swamp water. Drink enough of this and you'll turn red, too.

22429.Name: Cold Filtered Wurm Tincture
22429.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
Made high in the Shiverpeak Mountains using a secret wurm-bladder filtration process...it's not for everyone.

22431.Name: Raven Tonic
22431.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
A spiced, smoky concoction. Raven shamans make this, but nobody knows where or how.

22434.Name: Morgan's Orchid
22434.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
Morganas orchidae. This rare blossom is as beautiful as it is hardy. No one knows what gives it such resilience.

22435.Name: Toxal Bog Stew
22435.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
Brewed from mystery ingredients found in the Toxal Bog—equal parts hearty meal and bug repellent.

22437.Name: Tasty Meat
22437.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
The finest cut of meat at Meatoberfest. The smell of its flame-roasted goodness makes it impossible to resist.

22438.Name: Draithor's Lab's Powerfully Weird Meat
22438.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
This...food has an unfamiliar but tempting aroma. Probably best to eat it first and not ask questions.

22441.Name: Prototype Ooze Concentrate Tincture
22441.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
There's a faint whiff of something strange and powerfully concentrated. Drink this at your own risk.

22447.Name: Unidentified Beverage
22447.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
A bottle of liquid found near a fallen explorer in Orr. The origin of the beverage is unknown.

22450.Name: Sunken Rations
22450.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
These drowned rations are sodden with seawater.

22468.Name: Grawl Paint
22468.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
This clay is obviously magical. No wonder the grawl spread it all over the place. You should be able to imbue yourself with its essence.

22470.Name: Choya Stew
22470.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
It's unclear what's in this concoction, but just smelling it makes your nose twitch.

22471.Name: Spider Egg
22471.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
The spiders here grow very large. It stands to reason that their eggs must make you stronger...

22472.Name: Centaur Feed
22472.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
This is the feed from the local centaur tribe. It's mostly berries and grass, but you can smell some mystery ingredient... Must be good.

22474.Name: Bottle of Skrittsburgh Special
22474.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
A thick, hearty beverage favored in Skrittsburgh. It seems to contain some kind of grain along with trace tufts of fur.

22475.Name: Mysterious Meat
22475.Description:
Double-click to gain a hero point.
This strange fermented meat smells exotic. Maybe it's best not to think about where it came from.

22935.Description: Double-click to use. Hatch out a Mini-moa to dance for you.

—Haral

23304.Description:

—Bolla

23312.Name: Lionguard Patrol Badge
23312.Description:
"Long hours and hard work pays off."

23327.Description: <c=@flavor>A striking sample of a black moa's plumage.</c>

23333.Name: Dented Dredge Gear
23333.Description: <c=@flavor>"This had to be important for something."—Molesmasher</c>

23336.Name: Ancient Jotun Runestone
23336.Description:
"I wonder what the jotun used these for..."
—Albin Chronicler

23338.Name: Smashed Dragon Totem
23338.Description:
"It's odd to see the grawl worshipping something more powerful than barely shaped rocks."
—Tor the Tall

23339.Name: Tiny Dredge Tuning Fork
23339.Description:
"How do they eat with these things?"
—Surveyor Falki

23344.Name: Jora Totem
23344.Description: <c=@flavor>This totem features a relief of the fabled norn hero Jora.</c>

23345.Name: Commemorative Beer Stein
23345.Description: <c=@flavor>The inscription reads "In Commemoration Of The Krognars Pass Moot."</c>

23346.Name: Mini Mighty Oouo
23346.Description:
"A mini grawl might worship its mini likeness."
—Sizza

23347.Name: Graffiti-covered Stone
23347.Description:
"If you want to keep a piece, it's all yours."
—Crusader Brice

23348.Name: Goldenlight Hallow Lab Test Results
23348.Description:
"Normally only krewe members get to see these, but seeing how you helped generate the more interesting data points you can have them."
—Krewe Leader Seesa

23349.Name: Vigil Scout Medal
23349.Description:
"The Vigil recognizes your steadfastness in battle."
—Crusader Rugan

23350.Name: Stone Summit Dwarf Badge
23350.Description:
"These badges are amazing. There are so many interesting ranks, positions, honors. It was quite a complex military organization."
—Researcher Raekk

23351.Name: Priory Explorer's Medal
23351.Description:
"Takes courage to come out here. Thank you."
—Priory Explorer Cyara

23352.Name: Mortar and Pestle
23352.Description:
"Some think our poisons are potent because of the ingredients, the real trick is how you extract them."
—Ichtaca

23354.Name: Shiny Bottle Opener
23354.Description:
"We didn't need to steal these. We have claws. We took thems because they are so shiny. Cheers!"
—Cakilak'ka

23355.Name: Order Of Whispers Secret Code
23355.Description:
The only words visible are: "Talk time dark snow."
—Mensorr

23356.Name: Ancient Deldrimor Ring
23356.Description:
"Their metal working rivals that of the norn."
—Researcher Raekk

23357.Name: Commander's Ring
23357.Description:
"You lead like quaggan now. OOOoooOOooo"
—Commander Spleedoop

23359.Name: Ancient Stone Summit Shoulder Spike
23359.Description: <c=@flavor>"This artifact is more ornament than armament, but it gives hints of ancient craftsmanship."</c>

23360.Name: Cooking Spoon
23360.Description:
"A good cook needs a trusty spoon."
—Hune

23361.Name: Pet Rock
23361.Description: <c=@flavor>This used to be a pet for a skritt. A lonely, lonely skritt.</c>

23362.Name: Mining Lantern
23362.Description:
"These help for those really dark caves."
—Adgils

23363.Name: Grawl Tribal Paint
23363.Description:
"I wonder why grawl like orange so much."
—Arcanist Aurelio Shiverpaw

23364.Name: Dredge Manifesto
23364.Description:
"I find it fascinating that a blind creature can write."
—Rinceword

23365.Name: Order of Whispers Commendation
23365.Description:
"The order thanks you for all your help."
—Agent Kaukiri

23366.Name: Steam Sprocket
23366.Description:
"This is a part from a steam creature. I've studied it all I could. Maybe you'll find it more useful."
—Garrius

23367.Name: Dolyak Blanket
23367.Description:
"You need a good blanket to keep your dolyaks happy, because when they get upset no telling what will happen."
—Lyot

23368.Name: Frozen Imp Heart
23368.Description:
"Very interesting that the imp's heart seems frozen but still works."
—Suki

24262.Description: These are Inquest schematics. Roc'loaka the Tinkerer in Quandry Scratch may have a use for it.

24263.Name: Strand of Lush Kelp
24263.Description: Kelp containing possibly magical properties to combat Durotl poison? Who knew something so tiny could be so powerful? Blopp knew, that's who. And he'll probably want more of this.

24264.Name: Breeze Rider Essence
24264.Description: Magical dust from a breezerider. Rixt thinks this is what gives them their ability to fly. He might be interested in this.

24265.Name: Encryption Crystal
24265.Description: This crystal contains information that will help Frazz gain control of Bauxite Alchemicals faster.

24266.Name: Orrian Energy Source
24266.Description: This energy source could be the key to something...

24267.Name: Bittersweet Omnomberry
24267.Description: A special variety of Omnomberry that Byanca is particularly interested in.

24268.Name: Harpy Feather
24268.Description: A feather plucked from a harpy. Wode might find these useful.

24269.Name: Explosive Powder
24269.Description: Explosive power stolen from Separatists. Jahr Duskrend would probably want this.

24270.Name: Jotun Runestone
24270.Description: Albin Chronicler is very interested in these.

24271.Name: Discarded Sylvari Tool
24271.Description: Brannen outside of Caer Brier would probably want these.

24371.Name: Blue Wurm Husk
24371.Description:
An odd blue wurm husk
<c=@flavor>"This may have come from a Bug!"</c>

24414.Name: Tuning Crystal
24414.Description: These crystal shards were mined from the rocks around Ulta Metamagicals. Tekki is using them to tune her upgraded asura gates.

24415.Name: Cursed Pirate Artifact
24415.Description: Priory explorers have been searching for these.

24419.Name: Crabmeat
24419.Description: Hunk of crabmeat only enjoyed by quaggan. Doolsileep could make something tasty with this.

24421.Name: Meat Hunk
24421.Description: A large hunk of meat. Chef Mestergruff of Mennerheim might want this.

24426.Name: Firefly Essence
24426.Description: The hylek have been known to concoct powerful explosives by processing remains of luminescent insects.

24427.Name: Blackvein Fiber
24427.Description: Coating a weapon in these plant leaves will infect wounds delivered by them. Any Seraph in Harathi Highlands could use this.

24428.Name: Slice of Grub Meat
24428.Description: Forager Sneckit in Skrittsburgh Hillstead collects this meat so it can feed skritt throughout Skrittsburgh.

24430.Name: Seraph Supplies
24430.Description: These supplies were likely stolen by bandits and should be returned to Seraph Goran in The Wendon Steps.

24431.Name: Whetstone
24431.Description: Broil Cane's friends and members of the Companions could use these whetstones in their war against the centaur.

24432.Name: Green Stinkhorn
24432.Description: These pungent mushrooms are being harvested by the Durmand Priory, to be extracted and and turned into tonics that cure all kinds of ailments.

24433.Name: Undamaged Power-Bauble
24433.Description: Twitchok in Skrittsburgh Tunnels is collecting these.

24434.Name: Bandit Documents
24434.Description: These documents contain detailed information on the bandit activity in the region. The Seraph would be very interested in this intelligence.

24435.Name: Red Summoning Stone
24435.Description: A red stone that's warm to the touch. Scholar Inka is using these for her experiments.

24436.Name: Blue Summoning Stone
24436.Description: A cracked blue stone that's cold to the touch. Scholar Inka is using these for her experiments.

24437.Name: Black Summoning Stone
24437.Description: A black, brimstone-scented stone. Scholar Inka is using these for her experiments.

24438.Name: Kodan Supplies
24438.Description: Recovered supplies from Blue Ice Shining. Return these to Guard Splintering Serenity.

24440.Name: Volcanic Rock
24440.Description: A shard of pitch black volcanic rock. It is extremely sharp. Sangdo Swiftwing is interested in these.

24441.Name: Scrap Metal
24441.Description: Oddly marked scrap metal taken from the steam creatures.

24442.Name: Chunk of Unrefined Dredge Ore
24442.Description: Priory Arcanist Dotta in the north of Dostoev Sky Peak is breaking down this ore.

24447.Name: Treasure
24447.Description: Return these to Admiral Clarinda Demard at Forvar's Landing.

24448.Name: Explosive Powder
24448.Description: A special explosive that destroys steam creatures. Remember, don't use too much.

24450.Name: Frozen Fish
24450.Description: Guardian Infinite Mind in Groznev Delve is looking for these.

24451.Name: Moa Meat
24451.Description: Guardian Infinite Mind in Groznev Delve is looking for these.

24452.Name: Asuran Relic
24452.Description: Explorer Cryptcutter from Rata Pten in Mount Maelstrom is collecting these.

24453.Name: Chunk of Dolyak Meat
24453.Description: Enduring Protector is looking for meat to feed his refugees.

24454.Name: Barracuda Meat
24454.Description: Hunk of barracuda meat enjoyed by kodan. Enduring Protector is looking to feed the refugees with this.

24455.Name: Skritt Artifact
24455.Description: A forgetten artifact the skritt left behind in the rush to escape the risen. Just what Crusader Aisling is looking for.

36384.Name: Mad Memoires I: Boyhood
36384.Description:
In which His Royal Madness, yet but a boy, discovers the joys of humor.
—Dig deep in the muck, where all the garbage of Lion's Arch flows. (Site #1)
—Find Provernic, where the first king's bones rot in the hills. (Site #5)

36385.Name: Mad Memoires II: Friendship
36385.Description:
In which a friend joins young Oswald Thorn for the adventure of a lifetime.
—Say more now and look more where Kryta's descendants are buried. (Site #3)
—Go into the hills and set down black roots in stagnant waters. (Site #4)

36386.Name: Mad Memoires III: Young Love
36386.Description:
In which Os woos Lady Lyrica with graceless verve and uncomfortable silences.
—Go into the hills and set down black roots in stagnant waters. (Site #4)
—Find Provernic, where the first king's bones rot in the hills. (Site #5)

36387.Name: Mad Memoires IV: Deadly Adventures
36387.Description:
In which Os and his elder brother, Ewie, get into a sticky situation. Only one returns.
—Deep in the muck, where all the garbage of Lion's Arch flows. (Site #1)
—Search the dead streets and forgotten thoroughfares of another Lion's Arch. (Site #2)

36388.Name: Mad Memoires V: Betrothed
36388.Description:
In which Lord Oswald Thorn, the new heir to the throne, chooses his queen.
—Say more now and look more where Kryta's descendants are buried. (Site #3)
—Find Provernic, where the first king's bones rot in the hills. (Site #5)

36389.Name: Mad Memoires VI: Coronation
36389.Description:
In which His Royal Madness ascends to the Krytan throne and wields his first decree.
—Search the dead streets and forgotten thoroughfares of another Lion's Arch. (Site #2)
—Say more now and look more where Kryta's descendants are buried. (Site #3)

36390.Name: Mad Memoires VII: Handless
36390.Description:
In which King Thorn relieves thieves of their hands.
—This hinterland village was home to a goddess and a martyr. (Site #6)

36391.Name: Mad Memoires VIII: Feast and Famine
36391.Description:
In which the Mad King cries, "Let them eat candy corn!"
—These old bones are caught in the gullet, where laughing rises from sorrow. (Site #7)

36392.Name: Mad Memoires IX: Pains of Love
36392.Description:
In which Zola's father is afforded special hospitality during her engagement to King Thorn.
—The landing at Arca struggles to fill its storeroom so it will never starve again. (Site #8)

36393.Name: Mad Memoires X: Tax-o'-Lanterns
36393.Description:
In which the king makes an example of ungrateful peasants.
—Green is the color I want to remember. Not the red of flames or the blackened plateau. The bridge, even it was green. (Site #9)

36394.Name: Mad Memoires XI: Flames of Renewal
36394.Description:
In which a rebellious village goes up in flames.
—Walk in cadence with King Thorn's shattered subjects. They keep their hatred deep within. (Site #10)

36395.Name: Mad Memoires XII: Descension
36395.Description: In which Mad King Thorn is scattered to the four winds and departs for the Underworld.</c>

36396.Name: Candy-Powered Matter Meter
36396.Description:
This device detects power caches by attuning its frequency to one of the four types of matter: aqueous, gaseous, etheric, and corporeal. Activation requires at least one piece of candy corn.
"Tassi, where are you going with those blueprints? Those are Statics property! Hey!"
—Councilor Ludo

36397.Name: Mad Memoires
36397.Description:
A recollection of the life and deeds of Mad King Thorn, as recounted by his loyal subjects and friends. The volume ends with the coronation of King Thorn. It seems incomplete.
—Stories yet untold despite the tower that marks a spooky site. When humans flee their home of old, where they settle cannot be told.

36398.Name: Mad Memoires: Complete Edition
36398.Description:
A recollection of the life and deeds of Mad King Thorn, as told by his loyal subjects and friends. Contains a complete account of King Oswald Thorn's life, from boyhood to gruesome death.
"Even after death, I shall return! And all my enemies will burn, burn, BURN!"
—Mad King Thorn

39550.Description: <c=@flavor>Generations of norn-etched runes cover this dolyak horn. The most recent is a symbol of the Vigil.</c>

39551.Name: Totem of the Gorilla
39551.Description: <c=@flavor>An intrepid norn artist paid respect to a far-flung Spirit of the Wild with this carving.</c>

39554.Name: Fledgling Charm
39554.Description: <c=@flavor>Young tengu are given charms like this for protection.</c>

39555.Name: Anton's Secret
39555.Description: <c=@flavor>An item to be hidden in the most unlikely of places.</c>

39558.Name: Passiflora Karkinata
39558.Description: <c=@flavor>An extremely rare and powerful floral specimen.</c>

39559.Name: Ancient Karka Carapace
39559.Description: <c=@flavor>Part of the ancient karka that attacked Lion's Arch. Mysterious magics seem to be woven into its chitinous shell.</c>

39562.Name: Molten Ore
39562.Description: <c=@flavor>A dark artifact of the combined forces of the Flame Legion and dredge. This ore seems too impure to properly refine, but it gleams with dark potential.</c>

39563.Name: Big Mama's Tooth
39563.Description: <c=@flavor>Legends speak of "Big Mama," the largest drake broodmother that ever lived. If she still does, it seems she's short at least one tooth.</c>

39566.Name: Amulet of Protection
39566.Description: <c=@flavor>Stolen from the body of a long-forgotten lord during the Guild Wars.</c>

39567.Name: Salma's Diamond Jubilee Necklace
39567.Description: <c=@flavor>Queen Salma's reign was long and prosperous. Such prosperity has long been missed in Kryta.<c>

39571.Name: Amulet of the Skies
39571.Description: <c=@flavor>A talented Durmand Priory scholar based this necklace on ancient astrological charts found on jotun megaliths.</c>

39574.Name: Petrified Skull Juju
39574.Description: <c=@flavor>An ancient relic of the mystic beings of Echovald Forest.</c>

39575.Name: Nornbear's Remembrance
39575.Description: <c=@flavor>Once a painful reminder to Jora of her brother's curse.</c>

39578.Name: Archaic Grawl Necklace
39578.Description: <c=@flavor>From a time before the grawl had a spoken language.</c>

39579.Name: The Southsun Rose
39579.Description: <c=@flavor>The largest pink diamond in all of Tyria.</c>

39582.Name: Charisma
39582.Description: <c=@flavor>The locket contains a picture of Kolijn Johansson, Trade Administrator of Hoelbrak.</c>

39583.Name: Third-Place Medal
39583.Description: <c=@flavor>Congratulations from the Divinity's Reach Fancy Cat Association! Everyone is fancy in their own way.</c>

39586.Name: Prayer to Otter
39586.Description: <c=@flavor>Otter is a fickle spirit, but when she does grant a boon, it is a powerful gift indeed.</c>

39587.Name: The Queen's Necklace
39587.Description: <c=@flavor>Commissioned for Queen Jennah by a council member, but found too ornate for her tastes.</c>

39588.Name: Luxon Pendant
39588.Description: <c=@flavor>Smuggled out of Cantha long ago, a relic of the Serpent Clan.<c>

39589.Name: The Beetlestone Diamond
39589.Description: <c=@flavor>Mined from the Onyx Fields of Southsun Cove for the pleasure of Lord Beetlestone.</c>

39590.Name: Protomatter Chain
39590.Description: <c=@flavor>Some strange, ethereal material from the Mists has solidified into this odd necklace.</c>

63553.Name: Letter from Eir
63553.Description:
"Solvi will be sorely missed, but he died a hero's death free of corruption. We have you to thank for that."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63636.Name: Letter from Caithe
63636.Description:
"Let the loss of Ysvelta be a constant reminder of why we must stay strong against the Nightmare."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63637.Name: Letter from Caithe
63637.Description:
"Bercilak was a powerful foe, and you bested him in fair combat. Be proud of yourself."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63638.Name: Letter from Eir
63638.Description:
"With Korag gone, his remaining tribe may finally know peace. Take pride in their new beginning, Slayer."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63640.Name: Letter from Eir
63640.Description:
"If not for you, there's no telling what Vidkun would have done to Minotaur. You saved a Spirit of the Wild—no small task."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63641.Name: Letter from Logan
63641.Description:
"Even while acting as bait for Two-Blade Pete, you showed great courage. The Seraph, and I personally, owe you for your service."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63642.Name: Letter from Logan
63642.Description:
"We never would have discovered the depths of Zamon's treachery without you. You've made me, the Seraph, and Kryta very proud."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63643.Name: Letter from Logan
63643.Description:
"It's a great shame that Serentine's betrayal went unnoticed for so long. You've restored the reputation of the Seraph, and for that I'm sincerely grateful."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63644.Name: Letter from Rytlock
63644.Description:
"As both man and ghost, Warmaster Lebofski's sent more than a few charr to the grave. And you stood up to him. Seems I was right about you."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63645.Name: Letter from Rytlock
63645.Description:
"To keep cool while things heat up is a rare quality. You're a true testament to the Blood Legion."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63646.Name: Letter from Rytlock
63646.Description:
"Today you showed me cunning can cut deeper than a knife. Trybulus had us outnumbered, but we persevered. Good work."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63647.Name: Letter from Zojja
63647.Description:
"After your riveting success today, you deserve applause. Don't let Teyo's deeds sully what you've accomplished."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63648.Name: Letter from Zojja
63648.Description:
"Gadd's lab was quite the fortuitous discovery. There were...unforeseen side effects, but you handled yourself brilliantly."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63649.Name: Letter from Zojja
63649.Description:
"Astounding work! Kazz and Doxa couldn't be happier. Thanks to you, we've made amazing breakthroughs in metalurmagical bioessence divergences."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

63650.Name: Letter from Caithe
63650.Description:
"We'd have lost much had the stag died. Today was a triumph for nature, thanks to you."
Double-click to gain 50 luck.

66904.Description: <c=@flavor>And just like that, he's gone. A bag of his old belongings is all that's left.</c>

66905.Description: Double-click to learn the recipe for a Clay Pot.

66906.Name: Recipe: Plate of Meaty Plant Food
66906.Description: Double-click to learn the recipe for a Plate of Meaty Plant Food.

66907.Name: Recipe: Plate of Piquant Plant Food
66907.Description: Double-click to learn the recipe for a Plate of Piquant Plant Food.

66908.Name: Mysterious Seedling
66908.Description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant has a wild streak to it. A meal of purified Sacred Plant Food should help it grow to be more obedient.<c>

66909.Name: Mysterious Seed
66909.Description: <c=@flavor>Plant in a Ley Line Infused Clay Pot to germinate.<c>

66910.Name: Pet Seed
66910.Description: <c=@flavor>The next generation of cultivated seed produced by your own hand. To cultivate this new specimen to be even better than the last, plant it in a Mists Infused Clay Pot to germinate.</c>

66911.Name: Mysterious Sprout
66911.Description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant could use something with a bit more kick to keep it growing. Some Phantasmally Infused Plant Food should do the trick.<c>

66912.Name: Ley Line Infused Clay Pot
66912.Description:
Double-click to plant a Mysterious Seed in this pot.

<c=@flavor>Everything needed to germinate a very special seed is in this pot now.<c>

66913.Name: Clay Pot
66913.Description: <c=@flavor>Missing just a few things needed to germinate a seed.<c>

66914.Name: Polarized Ley Line Infused Stone
66914.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Clay Pot, Bloodstone Dust, and Foxfire Clusters to create a Ley Line Infused Clay Pot.

<c=@flavor>It's very difficult to focus your eyes on this stone. The space around it is rich with magical energy.<c>

66915.Name: Ley Line Infused Stone
66915.Description:
The polarity of this stone is locked in a stable matrix. A Ley Line disrupting device could unlock its potential forces.
Double-click to show.

66916.Name: Package of Sacred Plant Food
66916.Description:
Double-click to feed to a Mysterious Seedling.

<c=@flavor>Purified with Sacred Glacial Water to keep a wild plant well behaved while it matures.<c>

66917.Name: Plate of Meaty Plant Food
66917.Description: <c=@flavor>This mash of meaty, semi-toxic ingredients needs just a few more things to be the kind of food needed to calm a wild carnivorous plant.<c>

66918.Name: Vial of Sacred Glacial Water
66918.Description:
This water is warm and murky. It could be purified, but only at its source.
Double-click to show.

66919.Name: Purified Vial of Sacred Glacial Water
66919.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Meaty Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Sacred Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>This cool, clear mineral water from a sacred glacier could purify and nourish a magically growing plant.<c>

66920.Name: Package of Phantasmally Infused Plant Food
66920.Description:
Double-click to feed to a Mysterious Sprout.

<c=@flavor>This spicy snack has been infused with the essence of a phantasm and magically prepared for the connoisseur of carnivorous plants.<c>

66921.Name: Weirded Phantasmal Residue
66921.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Piquant Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Phantasmally Infused Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>A sticky pile of residue left behind by a powerful spirit.<c>

66922.Name: Pile of Phantasmal Residue
66922.Description:
This residue lies dormant. It could be imbued at a strong phantasmal energy source.
Double-click to show.

66923.Name: Plate of Piquant Plant Food
66923.Description: <c=@flavor>Just a couple ingredients shy of having the kind of kick an especially persnickety carnivorous plant would enjoy.<c>

66924.Name: Mysterious Vine
66924.Description: <c=@flavor>This vine, while appearing to be touched by Mordremoth, has been grown from seed under the good influence of a hero of Tyria.<c>

66926.Name: Endless Monkey King Tonic
66926.Description:
Double-click to drink, transforming you into the Monkey King for fifteen minutes. You will be unable to fight while transformed.
Account Bound on Use

66927.Name: Home Portal Stone
66927.Description:
Double-click to be transported to your home in your racial city.
Double-click while in your home to return to where you entered from.

66977.Name: Summit Hero's Reward
66977.Description: <c=@flavor>A gift given in gratitude from the leaders of Tyria.</c>

66978.Name: Recipe: Grow Lamp
66978.Description: Double-click to learn the recipe for a Grow Lamp.

66979.Name: Cultivated Sprout
66979.Description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant seems restless. Feed it something soothing, like Oasis Soaked Plant Food to calm it down.</c>

66980.Name: Cultivated Seedling
66980.Description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant looks hungry for something particularly magical. Some Ley Line Dusted Plant Food should satisfy its cravings.</c>

66981.Name: Cultivated Seed
66981.Description: <c=@flavor>The first seed cultivated and produced by your own hand. To cultivate this new specimen to be even better than the last, plant in a Chaos Infused Clay Pot to germinate.</c>

66982.Name: Cultivated Vine
66982.Description: <c=@flavor>This vine that you cultivated from seed, seems to almost like you. Is it possible that it is loyal to you as a child is to a parent?</c>

66983.Name: Resonating Chaos Orb
66983.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Clay Pot, Bloodstone Dust, and Foxfire Clusters to create a Chaos Infused Clay Pot.

<c=@flavor>This orb is clearly very powerful. It buzzes and warbles as if it can't contain its mirth.</c>

66984.Name: Chaos Infused Clay Pot
66984.Description:
Double-click to plant a Cultivated Seed in this pot.

<c=@flavor>A pot so infused with energy, it's sure to germinate a more powerful seedling.</c>

66985.Name: Chaos Orb
66985.Description:
A humming emanates from this orb. It could be amplified with an additional source of Chaotic Radiation.
Double-click to show.

66986.Name: Pile of Crackling Ley Line Dust
66986.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Meaty Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Ley Line Dusted Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>This dust crackles and pops with magical energy.</c>

66987.Name: Package of Ley Line Dusted Plant Food
66987.Description:
Double-click to feed to a Cultivated Seedling.

<c=@flavor>Dusted with Ley Line power to nourish a growing magical carnivorous plant.</c>

66988.Name: Pile of Ley Line Dust
66988.Description:
An inert pile of dust from a ley line. A jolt of energy from a specialized asuran lab will energize it.
Double-click to show.

66989.Name: Package of Oasis Soaked Plant Food
66989.Description:
Double-click to feed to a Cultivated Sprout.

<c=@flavor>Soaked in the clean, cool waters from a Maguuma oasis.</c>

66990.Name: Empty Vial
66990.Description: Can be filled with Mending Oasis Water by stepping into the oasis.

66991.Name: Vial of Mending Oasis Water
66991.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Piquant Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Oasis Soaked Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>The waters of the Maguuma Jungle are famous for having inherent healing powers.</c>

66992.Name: Enormous Foxfire Cluster
66992.Description:
This powerful cluster of foxfire still needs a catalyst to fully unlock its growth potential.
Double-click to show.

66993.Name: Grow Lamp
66993.Description: <c=@flavor>Just needs a little extra something to attune this lamp for maximum growth potential.</c>

66994.Name: Germinated Foxfire Cluster
66994.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Grow Lamp, Bloodstone Bricks, and exotic Essence of Luck to create an Attuned Grow Lamp.

<c=@flavor>A large and potent cluster of Foxfire.</c>

66995.Name: Attuned Grow Lamp
66995.Description:
Double-click to shine on a Cultivated Shoot.

<c=@flavor>With a hefty helping of luck, this lamp should get the most stubborn of plants to grow toward its light.</c>

66997.Name: Recipe: Heat Stone
66997.Description: Double-click to learn the recipe for a Heat Stone.

66999.Name: Mawdrey II
66999.Description: Double-click to feed 50 Piles of Bloodstone Dust in exchange for a gift. Mawdrey II will become full if fed too much dust in a day.

67000.Name: Pet Sprout
67000.Description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant could use something with a bit more kick to keep it growing. Some Rhand Blessed Plant Food should do the trick.</c>

67001.Name: Gift from Mawdrey II
67001.Description: Double-click to open Mawdrey II's gift.

67002.Name: Mawdrey (Infused)
67002.Description: <c=@flavor>After spending so much time cultivating this powerful vine through the generations, it's hard to not feel an attachment to it. Your beloved pet almost cuddles you in its tendrils. Clearly it feels a similar attachment.</c>

67003.Name: Pet Seedling
67003.Description: <c=@flavor>This young carnivorous plant looks hungry for something particularly magical. Some Elementally Charged Plant Food should satisfy its cravings.</c>

67004.Name: Mawdrey
67004.Description: <c=@flavor>After spending so much time cultivating this powerful vine through the generations, it's hard to not feel an attachment to it. Your beloved pet almost cuddles you in its tendrils. Clearly it feels a similar attachment.</c>

67005.Name: Pet Shoot
67005.Description: <c=@flavor>Growth seems to be slowing again. You need an even bigger kick of sun to speed back up the growth process. Something like a Powerful Grow Lamp would be perfect.</c>

67006.Name: Pet Plantling
67006.Description: <c=@flavor>Your dear plantling has grown quite a bit, but it seems to ache for the warmth of the Maguuma Jungle. Something to warm it thoroughly, like a Destroyer Heated Stone, should keep it toasty.</c>

67007.Name: Mists Stone
67007.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Clay Pot, Bloodstone Dust, and Foxfire Clusters to create a Mists Infused Clay Pot.

<c=@flavor>A stone taken from the Mists, steeped in its power.</c>

67008.Name: Mists Infused Clay Pot
67008.Description:
Double-click to plant your Pet Seed in this pot.

<c=@flavor>A pot infused with the energy of the Mists.</c>

67009.Name: Pile of Elemental Essence
67009.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Meaty Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Elementally Charged Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>A crackling pile of elementally charged essence.</c>

67010.Name: Package of Elementally Charged Plant Food
67010.Description:
Double-click to feed to your Pet Seedling.

<c=@flavor>Watch your fingers—this food occasionally gives you a bit of a jolt.</c>

67011.Name: Water of Rhand
67011.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with Piquant Plant Food, Bloodstone Dust, and Thick Leather Sections to create a Package of Rhand Blessed Plant Food.

<c=@flavor>The Font of Rhand is known to be a very magical place.</c>

67012.Name: Package of Rhand Blessed Plant Food
67012.Description:
Double-click to feed to your Pet Sprout.

<c=@flavor>Soaked in water from the Font of Rhand.</c>

67013.Name: Box of Captured Light
67013.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Grow Lamp, Bloodstone Bricks, and exotic Essence of Luck to create a Powerful Grow Lamp.

<c=@flavor>Every crack in its container glows from the light within.</c>

67014.Name: Powerful Grow Lamp
67014.Description:
Double-click to shine on your Pet Shoot.

<c=@flavor>Armed with a light that shone in the dark, this lamp is very powerful.</c>

67015.Name: Heat Stone
67015.Description: <c=@flavor>A simple heat stone isn't quite enough to channel the sweltering temperatures of the deep Maguuma Jungle.</c>

67016.Name: Destroyer Heated Stone
67016.Description:
Double-click to warm your Pet Plantling.

<c=@flavor>Special care should be taken with this hot stone if you don't want to get burned.</c>

67017.Name: Heart of the Destroyer
67017.Description:
Combine in the Mystic Forge with a Heat Stone, Bloodstone Bricks, and a +5 Agony Infusion to create a Destroyer Heated Stone.

<c=@flavor>A steaming hot stone from the core of a powerful Destroyer.</c>
